column1: # CADCraft Tamil (தமிழ்) interface catalog — original translations.
# License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the repository LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
# Written from CADCraft's English strings; no proprietary translations were copied. Most entries
# come from the Tamil CADCraft and shared catalogs in storytold/craft-i18n (`locales/ta/`); the
# rest were written for this file the same way.
# Clean room: every entry is written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Tamil computing and drafting vocabulary (அடுக்கு, தொகுதி, பரிமாணம், கோட்டு நிரப்பு, தளவமைப்பு,
# காட்சிப்புலம், பிடிப்புள்ளி…). No other product's Tamil interface, string table or terminology
# Empty context = ordinary label; @plural = one|other forms with {n}. Menu headings take their
# ordinary translation, so there are no `menu` rows.
# Keep command IDs, keywords, technology/product names and user data unchanged.
